'''Cedora''' is a maid at the [[Kin]]'s house in [[Ebou Dar]]. She is gray-haired and square-jawed with heavy shoulders and steely eyes.

==Activities==
Cedora opens the door of the Kin's house for [[Elayne]], [[Nynaeve]], and [[Setalle Anan]], and then escorts them to [[Reanne]]. She is respectful toward Setalle Anan.

When Elayne, Nynaeve, and [[Birgitte]] return accompanied by the other [[Aes Sedai]], Cedora is shocked at first and then escorts them to the [[Knitting Circle]].
